title: Stockfish vs ∞ Pawns
summary: Player starts with only a king and one pawn vs Stockfish's full army and gains one pawn each move to place anywhere. Game 1 ('and'): each turn the player moves AND places a pawn; player plays hyper-aggressively, builds micro pawn chains deep in Stockfish's camp (crazyhouse-like), and wins quickly with exd7-style capture plus a dropped promotion on d8. Game 2 ('either or'): each turn the player either moves a piece OR places a pawn; player walls up the position horde-style, then pushes to g7 and drops a queen (promotion) on h8 for checkmate. Won both.
rules: White: Ke1 + Pe2 only (official site). Black: full standard army, Stockfish full strength.
Mode 'and' (game 1): each player turn = one normal move AND then placing one pawn on any empty square.
Mode 'either or' (game 2): each player turn = either one normal move OR placing one pawn.
A pawn may be placed on any empty square as long as it doesn't leave the player's own king in check (official site).
Placing a pawn on the 8th rank promotes it immediately (video: 'drop a promotion on D8', 'drop queen to h8'; site prompts promotion choice).
Pawns on the 1st rank are allowed on the site (inferred from code: only check-legality is tested).
win_condition: Checkmate Stockfish. Video: won both modes.
